carpet.rule.cryingPortals.desc: Allows Crying Obsidian to be used in Nether portal frame
carpet.rule.commandPersonalRule.desc: Enables /personalrule command to set per-player gamerules
carpet.rule.allowedPersonalRules.desc: List of allowed gamerules for players to use
carpet.rule.allowedPersonalRules.extra: Use csv, like 'keepInventory,naturalRegeneration' for multiple rules, or 'all' for everything
carpet.rule.dimensionDisplay.desc: Shows players' current dimension in playerlist
carpet.rule.vaultCooldown.desc: Adds rewards cooldown to vaults in Trial chambers
carpet.rule.vaultCooldown.extra: Complex time like 2h30m is supported. 1d equals to the realtime day, 1c equals to the daylight cycle (20 minutes)
carpet.rule.loyalVoid.desc: Tridents with Loyalty enchantment will not be consumed by the void and will return
carpet.rule.raidGambit.desc: Using a goat horn applies the Glowing effect to raiders and makes a user their target
